trace.attempt_identity: Order of trace lines plus start/end uptime and wall-clock start; index assigned during readback.
trace.errno: Immediately captured in the next statement after each syscall return and restored after recording; values following successful syscalls may be stale.
trace.close: Original deferred close still occurs exactly once for every valid fd, before final logging; its return code and errno are observed.
trace.failure_handling: Serialization/write failures are suppressed and cannot replace the original returned Bool.
trace.added_time: Clock sampling and record/log overhead consume the unchanged outer deadline; no timeout extension.
